canonical_source.title: Munda Mimetic Reduplication
canonical_source.container: Canadian Journal of Linguistics / Revue canadienne de linguistique
canonical_source.scope: Comparative Munda-language study including Kera Mundari and Mundari; relevant to mimetic reduplication and sound symbolism. Not a general cultural authority.

verified_manifestations.notes: Repository metadata gives authors, publication date, journal, volume/issue/pages, DOI and abstract.

canonicalization.rule: Publisher, DOI, Swarthmore repository, indexing records, and lawful copies are manifestations of one scholarly work unless substantive version differences are demonstrated.

scope_and_evidence.verified_abstract_scope: The abstract reports an empirical typology of mimetic reduplication across seven Munda languages, considering syntactic class, semantic domain and phonological form.
scope_and_evidence.promotion_status: discovery/audit only pending lawful full-text inspection and exact locators

rights_access_consent.restriction: Do not infer pan-Munda cultural practice from a comparative linguistic pattern.
